text:
incident-bot: Pager: infer-usw node flap detected (kubelet restarts) — multiple NotReady events in last 4m. Affected: inference-pool-usw, ~8% 5xx, p99 latency up 2.1s. Paging #eng-oncall.

miguel: ACK. I'm taking.

sasha: oncall? I can jump if miguel is tied up.

miguel: I saw spike in 5xx from hosted API -> infer-usw. Starting quick triage.

miguel: kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-usw -o wide

sasha: got node list. 3 nodes reporting NotReady intermittently. One node shows kubelet restart count 5.

zoe: logs from runtime pods show repeated 'NVRM: Xid 79' and 'GPU hung' before container crash.

karthik: Xid 79 typically driver reset. Could be GPU driver kernel mismatch or OOM in kernel. Also seeing container runtime restart around same time.

miguel: grabbing node describe:
```
kubectl describe node ip-10-0-45-128
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From     Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----     -------
  Warning NodeNotReady  3m   kubelet  Kubelet stopped posting node status
  Warning KubeletRestart 2m   kubelet  Kubelet has restarted (exit code 2)
```

mia (infra-bot): Cloud alert: underlying hypervisor reported GPU driver fault on host hvm-198 — ticket #INC-4981 opened with provider.

miguel: immediate mitigation steps:
- cordon the repeatedly flapping nodes
- drain with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
- scale up infer-pool-usw autoscaler by +2 temporarily
- route traffic to fallback pool infer-use and infer-eu (via routing policy)

sasha: running:
```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-45-128
kubectl drain ip-10-0-45-128 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

sasha: draining succeeded for runtime pods, some pods evicted and rescheduled on other nodes.

tara: lowering runtime batching on live pods to reduce memory footprint (sets BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512) via patch to deployment -> should reduce steady-state GPU mem.

karthik: I pulled dmesg from node — repeated 'NVRM: GPU at 0000:01:00.0: Xid 79: context fault' and 'oom-kill' lines. Posting snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid 79: Xid d0bc0
[ 1234.568000] Out of memory: Killed process 3456 (redwood-runtime) total-vm:...
```

zoe: runtime logs also include 'cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory' before container restart.

miguel: customer impact: routed traffic helped but p99 still elevated until pods rescheduled. Not seeing mass data loss, mainly increased errors and timeouts for heavy embedding/large-context requests. Reached out to SRE on-call to raise capacity for fallback pools.

infra-bot: Provider acknowledges driver fault and is investigating host-level GPU kernel module crash. ETA unknown. Recommended isolate host and avoid scheduling GPUs there.

sasha: rolling restart across remaining nodes to pick up patched driver + runtime fallback? But avoid restarting all at once.

miguel: plan:
1) cordon affected hosts (done)
2) increase autoscaler min and replace drained nodes
3) apply temporary batching limits and model-level rate limits for embeddings
4) monitor 5xx and p99 for next 30m
5) if provider ETA >30m, we will migrate persistent inference backends to infer-dedicated (reserved) for high-priority customers and open support tickets.

karthik: opening infra ticket to escalate driver crash with cloud provider (link: https://provider/incidents/INC-4981) and attaching dmesg + nvml logs.

sasha: added quick dashboard alerts for 'NVRM Xid' pattern and 'kubelet restart >3 in 5m' so we can auto-page next time.

miguel: sounds good. I'll mark this thread as handoff to follow-up channel and update postmortem template.

tara: monitoring — p99 dropping back toward baseline as pods stabilize. current p99 delta: +0.4s, 5xx rate down to 1.2% from 8% at spike.

miguel: thanks all. Leaving on-call notes and scheduling RCA with infra + runtime team in 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.3.114 rolled out to infer-pool-usw to enforce BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512 (ci://deploy/2026.3.114) :rocket:

miguel: closing initial paging loop. Will keep watching. If we see driver Xid 79 again escalate immediately.

sasha: noted. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
